comparison.objective: Move an item into a carton without crossing finished goods; candidate tunes a robot-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Board task tests collision-aware transport and placement. Candidate tests recessed tool engagement, fine rotation, counterholding, torque control, and iterative commissioning.
comparison.success_condition: Stated success is carton placement along a safe path; candidate requires two quantitatively safe impact stops and a retained setting.
comparison.reason: Setup and scoring are explicitly missing, but the available objective still establishes a different ability from damper adjustment.
